profiles.CONSERVATIVE: Exact prior LIVE rules: three-frame closed EMA alignment, non-opposing 4h, EMA/Fibonacci confluence, RSI52..68/32..48, body recovery, partial volume >=1, MACD, netRR>=1.5
profiles.MODERATE: EMA20 pullback within .5 ATR plus .25 ATR quote tolerance; same closed5m/15m/1h alignment, RSI/body/volume/MACD gates; projected TP2.5R with ATR/recent stop; Fibonacci context warning. Opposing4h is warning only when abs(EMA20-EMA50)/ATR on closed1h >=.5 and netRR>=2; otherwise blocked. Normal netRR>=1.5.

sample.split_labels: July / August / September; all reused exploratory; no candidate selection on these slices

protocol.regimes: Causal closed1h: HIGH_VOL if ATR/close>=.01, else TREND_UP/DOWN if abs(EMA20-EMA50)/ATR>=.5 and trend nonneutral, otherwise RANGE. No future regime classification.
protocol.independent_oos: NOT_AVAILABLE: incomplete exposure registry and all local minute archive calendar previously viewed. New exchange or new file is not independent OOS.
